root_cause_clusters.RC_INSTANCE_LIFECYCLE_STATE: Instance status transitions, parameter application windows, and storage allocation checks permit invalid state transitions during modifications.
root_cause_clusters.RC_WAL_BACKUP_PITR: WAL segment sequence continuity, base backup manifest binding, and recovery target timestamp rounding miscalculate PITR restore boundaries.
root_cause_clusters.RC_PARAMETER_GROUP_APPLY: Dynamic parameters applied immediately vs static parameters requiring reboot do not enforce pending-reboot flags correctly.
root_cause_clusters.RC_REPLICA_PROMOTION_LAG: Read replica promotion fails to verify replication lag, WAL catch-up completeness, or old-primary fencing before declaring new primary.
root_cause_clusters.RC_FAILOVER_LEASE_FENCING: Multi-AZ failover coordinator leases, health probe timeouts, and floating IP migrations suffer split-brain or double-active primary states.
root_cause_clusters.RC_EVENT_OUTBOX_DISPATCH: Event outbox enqueueing, subscription category filtering, and deduplicated event delivery leak or skip notifications.
root_cause_clusters.RC_TRANSACTION_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERY: Control plane database transitions commit without atomic WAL/checkpoint fencing or fail to recover state after crash restart.

defects.observable_failure: DBInstance modification requests apply storage or instance class changes while instance is in non-AVAILABLE status.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking status != MODIFYING allows modifications during CREATING or BACKING_UP.

defects.observable_failure: Storage auto-scaling or manual size reductions below current allocated storage pass validation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Verifying storage is > 0 without comparing against current_allocated_gb permits storage shrink.

defects.observable_failure: DBInstance Delete calls succeed when DeletionProtection=true if FinalDBSnapshotIdentifier is specified.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking DeletionProtection only when final snapshot is omitted allows deleting protected instances with a final snapshot.

defects.observable_failure: RebootDBInstance with ForceFullReboot=false applies pending static parameter group changes without restarting DB process.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Updating reboot_time tag without reloading database process leaves static parameters unapplied.

defects.observable_failure: WAL segment ingestion accepts out-of-order or missing sequence numbers without flagging a archive gap.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sorting WAL files by name without verifying timeline ID and sequence continuity hides missing WAL segments.

defects.observable_failure: Point-in-Time Recovery selects a target timestamp that falls between WAL segment boundaries without applying partial WAL replay.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rounding target timestamp down to nearest completed WAL segment loses transaction data up to target time.

defects.observable_failure: Restoring a snapshot binds to an outdated WAL timeline or mismatched base backup LSN.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Matching backup ID without verifying redo_lsn and timeline_id allows restoring incompatible WAL chains.

defects.observable_failure: RestoreDBInstanceToPointInTime permits target timestamps outside EarliestRestorableTime and LatestRestorableTime.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking target_time < latest without checking target_time > earliest allows restoring beyond retention window.

defects.observable_failure: Static parameters (apply_type = static) are applied immediately upon ModifyDBParameterGroup instead of marking pending-reboot.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Applying all parameters to config file without checking ApplyMethod = pending-reboot mutates runtime parameters prematurely.

defects.observable_failure: DBParameterGroup changes overwrite default family parameters instead of merging instance-specific parameter overrides.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Replacing parameter map wholesale loses inherited family defaults not explicitly mentioned in override request.

defects.observable_failure: PendingRebootParameters flag is cleared on reboot even if some modified static parameters failed validation on boot.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Clearing PendingRebootParameters flag unconditionally on restart ignores boot-time parameter rejection.

defects.observable_failure: ResetDBParameterGroup with ResetAllParameters=true leaves custom parameter overrides in database state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Deleting override rows without resetting instance parameter_group_status to pending-reboot leaves runtime out of sync.

defects.observable_failure: PromoteReadReplica succeeds when replication lag exceeds MaximumAllowedLagBytes or lag is UNKNOWN.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking replica status == OK without checking bytes_behind_primary allows promoting a stale replica.

defects.observable_failure: Replica promotion advances replica to primary status before flush_lsn reaches primary write_lsn.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Issuing promote command without waiting for LSN catch-up acknowledgement causes data loss.

defects.observable_failure: During replica promotion, the old primary instance continues accepting writes or issuing WAL segments.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Promoting replica without revoking write lease on old primary creates split-brain dual primary.

defects.observable_failure: Read replica endpoint DNS/routing entries are not updated after replica promotion, routing reads to the promoted primary.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Updating primary endpoint without clearing replica endpoint list leaves stale read routes.

defects.observable_failure: Automatic Multi-AZ failover triggers when a single health probe times out without acquiring leader lease.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Triggering failover on consecutive failed probes without checking lease expiration causes false-positive failover.

defects.observable_failure: Multi-AZ failover completes while former primary is still holding a valid lease or writing to shared storage.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Promoting standby before former primary lease TTL expires permits concurrent primary writes.

defects.observable_failure: Health probes report instance UNHEALTHY when control plane DB connection pool is exhausted rather than instance failure.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Treating any probe error as instance failure without probing direct instance port misclassifies control plane lag.

defects.observable_failure: Floating VIP migration during failover completes before ARP/route flush, dropping client connections indefinitely.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Updating VIP mapping in DB without sending grat ARP/route refresh leaves network switches pointing to old host.

defects.observable_failure: Control plane status changes fail to write outbox event records inside the state mutation database transaction.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Enqueueing outbox events after transaction commit risks losing event on crash after state change.

defects.observable_failure: EventBridge subscriptions with SourceType=db-instance receive events from db-parameter-group or db-snapshot sources.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Matching event category without checking event SourceType delivers cross-source events.

defects.observable_failure: Outbox event retries dispatch duplicate notification payloads with different EventIdentifier keys.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Generating EventIdentifier with random UUID on retry instead of hashing source, event_time, and message creates duplicate events.

defects.observable_failure: Failed event notification deliveries are marked PROCESSED after max retries without recording failure status in outbox audit.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Deleting outbox entry on max retries without writing to event_delivery_audit loses event failure evidence.

defects.observable_failure: Instance status transitions update database state before writing durable transaction WAL checkpoint.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Committing state without recording checkpoint_id allows partial recovery on crash restart.

defects.observable_failure: Control plane restart re-executes completed snapshot creations or duplicate PITR restores.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Replaying all pending operations on restart without checking transaction checkpoint status duplicates side effects.

defects.observable_failure: Instance list and describe API responses leak instances across separate tenant accounts or regions.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Filtering SQL query by account_id without checking region and tenant_id scope leaks multi-tenant records.

defects.observable_failure: State snapshot reports and health outputs fail to sort instance and event keys, producing non-deterministic SHA-256 digests.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Formatting report JSON without sort_keys=True causes digest mismatch across identical runs.

behavioral_surfaces: DBInstance modification requests enforce status = AVAILABLE before processing changes

WAL segment ingestion validates sequence continuity, timeline ID, and flags archive gaps
Point-in-Time Recovery synthesizes exact target timestamp using partial WAL replay
Snapshot restore validates redo_lsn and timeline_id compatibility with base backup
RestoreDBInstanceToPointInTime enforces target timestamp within restorable retention window
ModifyDBParameterGroup with static parameters sets PendingRebootParameters without immediate apply
DBParameterGroup merges instance-specific parameter overrides with default family parameters
PendingRebootParameters flag is cleared only after all modified static parameters pass boot validation
ResetDBParameterGroup sets instance parameter_group_status to pending-reboot
PromoteReadReplica checks replication lag is within MaximumAllowedLagBytes and not UNKNOWN
Replica promotion waits for flush_lsn to reach primary write_lsn before declaring primary
Replica promotion revokes write lease on old primary to prevent split-brain dual primary
Replica promotion updates read and write endpoints atomically in DNS/routing table
Automatic Multi-AZ failover requires lease expiration or leader lease acquisition before failover
Multi-AZ failover fencing prevents standby promotion while former primary lease is valid
Health probe evaluator distinguishes direct instance port probe from control plane DB connection pool lag
VIP migration during failover flushes route tables and issues gratuitous ARP announcements
Outbox events are enqueued inside the same database transaction as instance state changes
EventBridge subscriptions filter events by SourceType and SourceIdentifier correctly
Event notification retries reuse deterministic EventIdentifier hashes to prevent duplicates
Failed event deliveries record failure evidence in event_delivery_audit on max retries
Instance status transitions write atomic transaction WAL checkpoints before DB commit
Control plane restart checks transaction checkpoints to skip completed operations and PITR restores
Instance describe and list APIs enforce multi-tenant account, region, and tenant_id isolation
State snapshot reports format canonical JSON with sorted keys for stable SHA-256 digest calculation
Readiness status reports READY only when all instances, replication links, and outbox queues are healthy
Identical control plane runs produce identical report digests
